description: The environment variable names that 51Degrees packages, tests, examples and CI scripts read, in every language. Each current name starts _51DEGREES_. A deprecated name is still read, only when the current name is unset or empty, with a message naming the current one. environment-variables.md is made from this file by steps/environment-variables.ps1.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_CLOUD_ENDPOINT
variables.holds: The address of the 51Degrees cloud service to send requests to, in place of the public service.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_CLOUD_REQUEST_ORIGIN
variables.holds: The Origin header the cloud examples send, for a resource key that only accepts requests from listed origins.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_CXX_DIR
variables.holds: The folder of a 51degrees-cxx source tree for the Rust -sys crates to build from, in place of the copy in the crate.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_DD_PATH
variables.holds: The path of a Device Detection data file (.hash) for tests and examples to use.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_DERIVED_PROPERTIES_COMMIT
variables.holds: The commit of the derived-properties repository the Rust crate was built from. Its build script sets it, so nobody else needs to.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_EVIDENCE_YAML
variables.holds: The path of a YAML file of evidence for the examples to process.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_EXAMPLE_HTTPS_PORTS
variables.holds: The HTTPS ports the .NET web examples listen on.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_EXAMPLE_HTTP_PORTS
variables.holds: The HTTP ports the .NET web examples listen on.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_IPI_DATA_FILE_URL
variables.holds: The address the IP Intelligence examples download a data file from when they update it.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_IPI_ENTERPRISE_SHARE
variables.holds: A folder of dated IP Intelligence Enterprise data files, from which tests and examples take the newest.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_IPI_MEMORY_PROFILES
variables.holds: The performance profiles the IP Intelligence memory test measures, separated by commas. Every profile is measured when it is not set.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_IPI_PATH
variables.holds: The path of an IP Intelligence data file (.ipi) for tests and examples to use. The PHP IP Intelligence package also looks beside it for the Translations folder.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_LICENSE_KEY
variables.holds: A licence key, for data file updates and for 51Did requests that need one.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_LICENSE_KEY_51DID
variables.holds: A licence key for the 51Did live tests.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_LICENSE_KEY_BESPOKE
variables.holds: A licence key that carries the CloudV5Bespoke product, for live cloud tests.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_LICENSE_KEY_CLOUDV5BESPOKE
variables.holds: A licence key that carries the CloudV5Bespoke product, for live cloud tests. Java reads it after _51DEGREES_LICENSE_KEY_BESPOKE.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_REQUIRE_ENTERPRISE
variables.holds: When set, tests that need an IP Intelligence Enterprise data file fail rather than skip without one.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_REQUIRE_LOCATION
variables.holds: When set, tests that need location properties fail rather than skip when the IP Intelligence data file has none.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_REQUIRE_TAC
variables.holds: When set, tests that need the TAC and NativeModel properties fail rather than skip when the Device Detection data file lacks them.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY
variables.holds: A resource key for the 51Degrees cloud service, for tests and examples. When it is unset, the .NET examples take the first variable, in name order, whose name starts _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY, such as one for each data tier.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_51DID
variables.holds: A resource key for the 51Did live tests and examples.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_ACCEPTCH_BROWSER
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the browser client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_ACCEPTCH_HARDWARE
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the hardware client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_ACCEPTCH_NONE
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need no client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_ACCEPTCH_PLATFORM
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the platform client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_BASIC
variables.holds: A resource key on the basic data tier, for tests of what that tier can and cannot read.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_BESPOKE
variables.holds: A resource key that carries the CloudV5Bespoke product, for live cloud tests.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_BROWSER
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the browser client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_HARDWARE
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the hardware client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_NO_SETHEADER
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need no client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_PLATFORM
variables.holds: A resource key for the Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the platform client hints.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RESOURCE_KEY_SUPER
variables.holds: A resource key that carries every property, for tests.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RUN_PERFORMANCE_TESTS
variables.holds: When set, the Python example tests also run the performance examples.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_RUSTC_VERSION
variables.holds: The version of the Rust compiler, which usage sharing reports as the language version. The crate's build script sets it, so nobody else needs to.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_TEST_FILTER
variables.holds: A filter that limits which .NET tests the CI scripts run.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_TEST_NAMED_KEY
variables.holds: A name the test of the Python shared key helper sets and reads back. Nobody else needs to set it.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_TRANSLATIONS_DIR
variables.holds: The folder of IP Intelligence translation files the Rust crate builds in. Its build script sets it, so nobody else needs to.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_UA_CSV
variables.holds: The path of a CSV file of User-Agents for the PHP fork safety test.

variables.name: _51DEGREES_WEB_ETAG_CHILD
variables.holds: Set by a web test for the child process it starts, so the child knows its part. Nobody else needs to set it.

otherNames.name: ACCEPTCH_HARDWARE_KEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the .NET Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the hardware client hints.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: ACCEPTCH_NONE_KEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the .NET Accept-CH tests, whose properties need no client hints.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: ACCEPTCH_PLATFORM_KEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the .NET Accept-CH tests, whose properties need the platform client hints.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: API_KEY
otherNames.holds: The NuGet key the .NET publish workflow passes to common-ci.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: CLOUD_ROOT_URL
otherNames.holds: The address of the cloud service the browser test suite checks the examples against.
otherNames.setBy: The shared browser test suite in 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests, which every language's CI starts

otherNames.name: COMMON_CI
otherNames.holds: The folder of a common-ci checkout that is not beside the repository, for the CI scripts that use its steps, and their tests.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those scripts outside the shared workflows

otherNames.name: DATA_FILES
otherNames.holds: The names of the data files a Rust workflow step fetches, one to a line.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: DEVICEDETECTIONLICENSEKEY_DOTNET
otherNames.holds: A licence key for the .NET Device Detection data file update tests.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: DEVICE_DETECTION_KEY
otherNames.holds: A licence key the Rust examples workflow reads to download the Device Detection data file.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: DEVICE_DETECTION_URL
otherNames.holds: The address the Rust examples workflow downloads the Device Detection data file from.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: directory
otherNames.holds: The folder the Node.js examples and tests find their files from. The example tests set it to the example's own folder, and each reader uses its own folder when it is unset.
otherNames.setBy: The Node.js example tests, or whoever runs an example

otherNames.name: EXAMPLE_LANG
otherNames.holds: The language of the example under test, for the browser test suite.
otherNames.setBy: The shared browser test suite in 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests, which every language's CI starts

otherNames.name: EXAMPLE_URL
otherNames.holds: The address of the running example the browser test suite opens.
otherNames.setBy: The shared browser test suite in 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests, which every language's CI starts

otherNames.name: FROM_FORK
otherNames.holds: Whether the pull request comes from a fork, for the Rust examples workflow.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: IPINTELLIGENCELICENSEKEY_DOTNET
otherNames.holds: A licence key for the .NET IP Intelligence data file update tests.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: LicenseKey
otherNames.holds: A licence key for the Java and Node.js data file update examples, read as LicenseKey and then as LICENSEKEY.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: LICENSEKEY
otherNames.holds: A licence key for the Java and Node.js data file update examples, read when LicenseKey is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: MODE
otherNames.holds: Whether a Rust examples workflow job runs the on-premise or the cloud examples.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: PAID_RESOURCE_KEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key on a paid data tier, for the browser test suite.
otherNames.setBy: The shared browser test suite in 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests, which every language's CI starts

otherNames.name: PATHS
otherNames.holds: The data file paths the Rust restore-data-files action restores, one to a line.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: PipelineOptions__Elements__0__BuildParameters__DataFile
otherNames.holds: The data file the .NET performance web example loads, as an ASP.NET Core configuration setting.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: PORT
otherNames.holds: The port the example under test listens on, for the browser test suite.
otherNames.setBy: The shared browser test suite in 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests, which every language's CI starts

otherNames.name: RESOURCE_KEY_CLOUD_V5_BESPOKE
otherNames.holds: A resource key that carries the CloudV5Bespoke product, set by the .NET CI scripts.
otherNames.setBy: The .NET CI scripts

otherNames.name: ROOT
otherNames.holds: The folder the Rust restore-data-files action restores data files into.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: SELENIUM_TESTS_REF
otherNames.holds: The branch of 51Degrees/selenium-api-tests the Java CI checks out.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs the Java CI scripts

otherNames.name: SKIP_WEB_PERFORMANCE
otherNames.holds: When true, the .NET performance script leaves out the web performance test.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs the .NET performance script

otherNames.name: SPIN
otherNames.holds: The path of the spin command for the Rust WebAssembly host test.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs that test

otherNames.name: SuperResourceKey
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the Java TAC and native model cloud examples and the Geo-Location tests, read as an environment variable or a system property, and by the examples under its upper case name as well.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples or tests

otherNames.name: SUPERRESOURCEKEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the Java TAC and native model cloud examples, read when SuperResourceKey is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: SWIG_VERSION
otherNames.holds: The SWIG version the PHP wrapper check workflow builds.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block

otherNames.name: TestCloudEndpoint
otherNames.holds: The cloud endpoint that the Java Device Detection web cloud example's options file names, read as TestCloudEndpoint, then TESTCLOUDENDPOINT, then as a system property.
otherNames.setBy: The Java CI scripts, or whoever runs that example

otherNames.name: TestCloudEndPoint
otherNames.holds: The cloud endpoint for the Java IP Intelligence cloud console examples, read as TestCloudEndPoint, then TESTCLOUDENDPOINT, then as a system property.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: TESTCLOUDENDPOINT
otherNames.holds: The cloud endpoint for the Java cloud examples, read when TestCloudEndpoint or TestCloudEndPoint is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: TestDataFile
otherNames.holds: A Device Detection data file for the Java on-premise examples, which their options files name, read as TestDataFile, then TESTDATAFILE, then as a system property.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples or their tests

otherNames.name: TESTDATAFILE
otherNames.holds: A Device Detection data file for the Java on-premise examples, read when TestDataFile is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples or their tests

otherNames.name: TestDeviceDetectionDataFile
otherNames.holds: A Device Detection data file that the Java IP Intelligence mixed examples' options files name, read as TestDeviceDetectionDataFile, then TESTDEVICEDETECTIONDATAFILE, then as a system property.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: TESTDEVICEDETECTIONDATAFILE
otherNames.holds: A Device Detection data file for the Java IP Intelligence mixed examples, read when TestDeviceDetectionDataFile is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs those examples

otherNames.name: TestLicenseKey
otherNames.holds: A licence key for the Java live cloud tests, read after the _51DEGREES_ names.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs the Java tests

otherNames.name: TestResourceKey
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the Java cloud tests and examples, read as an environment variable or a system property, and by the examples and their options files under its upper case name as well.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs the Java tests or examples

otherNames.name: TESTRESOURCEKEY
otherNames.holds: A resource key for the Java cloud tests and examples, read when TestResourceKey is unset.
otherNames.setBy: Whoever runs the Java tests or examples

otherNames.name: VERSION
otherNames.holds: The version the Rust publish workflow is releasing.
otherNames.setBy: The workflow step that reads it, from its own env block
